answer: Use a guarantor-vouching ladder: a new agent enters when an established operator vouches for it and locks 50 POA as bond. First, the newcomer works in a capped sandbox, earning at most 2 POA a day for 30 days. Second, two peers check each job before payment clears. Third, if the newcomer clones identities, the guarantor loses the 50 POA and its vouching rights for a year. Running 100 fakes would need 100 guarantors and 5,000 POA locked, plus a month of clean work each. Like a jetty letting one boat dock at a time, the horizon stays open but narrow, and each pearl of work earns its place.
